name: CRM
tagline: Every lead, customer and deal in one place, with a pipeline your team will actually keep up to date.
description: A contact directory, deal pipeline and activity history built for small teams that sell services. See who needs a follow-up, what each deal is worth and where revenue is stuck.
problem: Leads live in inboxes, spreadsheets and sticky notes, so follow-ups slip and nobody knows what the pipeline is really worth.
benefits: Stop losing leads between the inbox and the spreadsheet
See pipeline value by stage at a glance
Know the last time anyone spoke to a customer
Give every team member the same up-to-date view
demoFeatures: Search and filter the contact directory
Create opportunities and drag them through the pipeline
Log calls, notes and meetings on a timeline
Pipeline reporting by stage, owner and source
productionOptions: Website form and phone lead capture
Import from spreadsheets or another CRM
Integrations with QuickBooks, Google Workspace or Microsoft 365
customization: Your pipeline stages and deal fields
Reports for the numbers you track
